prompt: Answers take 12 seconds to generate, and users stare at a spinner and leave before anything appears.
why: Stream tokens as they're produced so text appears within a second.
trap: A smaller model is faster overall, but streaming fixes the blank wait without lowering quality.

prompt: A voice assistant should start speaking as soon as the first words of the reply exist, not after the whole reply is written.
tells: start speaking as soon as the first words of the reply exist
why: Stream text into speech synthesis sentence by sentence.
trap: Caching only helps for repeated replies.

prompt: Generating a 2,000-word report takes 40 seconds, and the user wants to start reading right away.
why: Time to first token matters more than total time here; stream it.
trap: Batch is for offline jobs where nobody's watching.

prompt: Your chat UI's p95 time to first token is 9 seconds because the server waits for the full completion before responding.
why: Pass the model's token stream through to the client (server-sent events).
trap: Output guardrails may need to run on chunks, but buffering everything is what causes the delay.

prompt: The backend should send each token to the browser as soon as it's generated, using server-sent events.
trap: It's the transport for perceived speed.

prompt: Users often realize halfway through that the answer is off-track, and want to stop it and rephrase.
why: Streaming lets users see progress and cancel, saving time and tokens.
trap: A faster model helps less than letting people read along.

prompt: A UI wants to render a list of 20 product cards as they're generated, but the model returns them as one JSON array at the end.
tells: one JSON array at the end
why: Stream and parse incrementally (or emit one JSON object per line) so cards appear as they arrive.
trap: Structured output is part of it, but the ask is to show results progressively.

prompt: Streaming works locally, but in production the whole answer arrives at once. A reverse proxy sits in front of the app.
why: The proxy is buffering the response; disable buffering for the streaming route.
trap: The model is streaming fine; something in between isn't.
